name: mistika-workflows
description: Let your AI assistant handle your media tasks: transcodes and proxies, color, metadata, VFX pulls, AI dubbing and transcription, QC, deliveries and watch folders, built and run with Mistika Workflows on your own computer.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the media task you need, and the assistant builds and runs it with Mistika Workflows, SGO's node-based media automation application, on your own computer: transcodes and proxies (ProRes, DNxHR, H.264, H.265, OpenEXR, also from camera RAW), color pipelines (ACES, CDLs, 3D LUTs, Dolby Vision tone mapping), metadata reports and file management with checksums, EDL-based conforms and VFX pulls, automated QC and loudness checks, AI dubbing and transcription, deliveries and transfers (Aspera, Signiant, MASV, FTP, AWS S3, cloud drives, Frame.io, YouTube, Vimeo), notifications, and watch folders that start a workflow when files arrive.

The media is processed locally by Mistika Workflows, with color management, metadata preserved and a task queue with a log for every run. You can open Mistika Workflows to watch the workflows the assistant builds, adjust them by hand and save them as templates for your team.

The plugin adds two skills: one that carries out media tasks with Mistika Workflows, and one that installs Mistika Workflows and connects it to the ChatGPT desktop app or Codex, step by step.

Requirements and limitations: Mistika Workflows 11.7 or later, installed on your computer with its own license. Its tools work in the ChatGPT desktop app and in Codex on the computer where Mistika Workflows is installed; they are not available in ChatGPT on the web or on mobile. Services and applications from other companies, such as ElevenLabs, Amberscript, QC tools or cloud storage, need your own account or installation.
capabilities: Conform and pull VFX plates from EDLs
